title: Job Interviews & Career 求职面试

articles.title: Job Interviews & Career 求职面试
articles.summary: Answering questions and showcasing strengths in interviews.

sentences.orig: Could you walk me through your most significant professional achievement and the role you played in it?
sentences.trans: 您能谈谈您最重要的职业成就以及您在其中扮演的角色吗？

sentences.orig: I believe my experience in cross-functional team management aligns well with the requirements of this position.
sentences.trans: 我相信我在跨职能团队管理方面的经验与该职位的要求高度契合。

sentences.orig: One of my key strengths is the ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances while maintaining a high standard of work.
sentences.trans: 我的一个关键优势是能够快速适应变化的环境，同时保持高标准的工作质量。

sentences.orig: The challenge I faced taught me the importance of resilience and proactive problem-solving under pressure.
sentences.trans: 我面临的挑战教会了我在压力下保持韧性并主动解决问题的重要性。

sentences.orig: I'm particularly drawn to this opportunity because it aligns with my long-term career aspirations in international business.
sentences.trans: 我特别看重这个机会，因为它与我在国际商务领域的长期职业抱负相契合。

sentences.orig: Could you elaborate on the career progression opportunities available within the organisation?
sentences.trans: 您能详细说明组织内的职业发展机会吗？

sentences.orig: My previous role equipped me with strong analytical skills, which I believe are essential for success in this position.
sentences.trans: 之前的职位使我具备了强大的分析能力，我认为这些能力对在该职位取得成功至关重要。

sentences.orig: I've always been proactive in seeking feedback and continuously improving my performance.
sentences.trans: 我一直主动寻求反馈，不断改进自己的工作表现。

questions.question: What does "walk me through" mean in an interview?
Why is the candidate drawn to the opportunity?
What skills did the previous role equip the candidate with?
